rules: REQUIRED manifest.input: version=1 (integer), profile=five-way, back=root or custom. Nested pages use custom and AtomApp.navigation.setBackHandler; root returns via AtomApp.home().

Four directions move semantic focus. Space is the keyboard simulation of the center key: short release confirms, hold 650ms invokes voice, release ends recording. Never intercept Space/arrows globally or issue a short click after a hold.

A focused editable text field receives system dictation at the selection, preserving other text and never automatically submitting. Password fields exclude dictation. Do not implement a competing recorder.

Use native labeled buttons, links, inputs, textareas and selects. Custom interactive controls require role, tabindex=0 and working click activation. Every core flow must be reachable without hover, drag, right click or double click as its only route.

Canvas/WebGL scenes must declare input.scene=controls and expose core actions as focusable DOM controls, or scene=passive only for viewing-only artwork. Do not falsely label interactive scenes passive.

The injected runtime owns the top-left back control. Reserve sufficient safe area, at least 48x48. App-owned menu headers use a left chevron plus parent label at top left and centered current title at its existing font size; no parent navigation at top right and no duplicate back control.

The injected runtime owns #atom-focus-ring: one animated ring per document, 140ms move/resize, 100ms entry, 120ms confirmation. Do not copy or override it. Focus and activation are immediate; motion cannot block or queue input.

Follow system motion preference and prefers-reduced-motion. Pointer use hides joystick focus feedback. Disabled/hidden controls are excluded; modal focus is contained and restored after closing. Stable element ids or data-atom-focus help restore focus after rendering.
Target 480x360 fullscreen with no permanent system chrome. Only necessary bounded content regions scroll. Keep the selected item visible and return to the original desktop page.
Use AtomApp lifecycle and acknowledged persistence. Use current semantic theme tokens; the shared ring follows --atom-focus-color or theme action color. Release audio, timers and GPU work on suspend.

Do not auto-certify legacy apps or merely add a compliance declaration without adapting behavior. Static checks are admission only: test core flows, nested back, modals, scrolling, long/short exclusion, dictation, motion-off and mouse switching. Application installation/update and new market publication enforce the contract.
